title: Clearbit Review (2026)
intro: Clearbit is evaluated here as sales intelligence software — Clearbit is HubSpot’s B2B data enrichment product, now part of HubSpot Breeze Intelligence — used to enrich CRM records and power inbound/account intelligence, monetized via HubSpot credits rather than a standalone classic SI database. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s sales-intelligence methodology (contact data, prospecting, enrichment, email outreach, CRM sync, usability, reporting, value). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Clearbit / Breeze Intelligence when HubSpot-native enrichment is the job and you already (or will) buy HubSpot credits.
verdict: Choose Clearbit / Breeze Intelligence when HubSpot-native enrichment is the job and you already (or will) buy HubSpot credits. Compare Clay for multi-provider waterfalls, Lusha for SMB enrichment+contact data, ZoomInfo for enterprise databases, and Apollo for prospecting+sequences. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Clearbit remains a strong firmographic/person enrichment source, but packaging and coverage are now framed through HubSpot Breeze Intelligence rather than a standalone mega-database.
Not positioned as a primary outbound list-building SI tool — prospecting score is intentionally low versus Apollo/Seamless-class products.
Enrichment is the product’s historic and current center of gravity — CRM fill and inbound intelligence are the buying jobs.
Not an email sequencer or outreach platform — score reflects enrichment-only posture.
Native HubSpot delivery plus connectors make CRM enrichment sync a first-class path.
For HubSpot customers, enrichment UX is comparatively straightforward versus multi-provider waterfall tools.
Light versus dedicated SI analytics — reporting lives mostly in HubSpot context.
Strong when already on HubSpot and credits fit usage; weaker if you need a standalone SI suite with published seats.

faq.question: Is Clearbit a CRM?
faq.answer: No. Clearbit is sales intelligence / prospecting software. Keep a CRM of record (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, etc.) and use Clearbit for discovery, enrichment, intent, or account prioritization as applicable.

faq.question: How is Clearbit priced?
faq.answer: Usage/credit packaging via HubSpot (Clearbit → Breeze Intelligence). No classic free SI plan; typically requires HubSpot Starter+. Enrichment credit packs are contact-sales. Confirm current Breeze Intelligence pricing on HubSpot.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Clearbit?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage.
